pr_title: ebs br: provide fsr warmup to tikv data volumes
pr_body:
<!--

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number:
close #47271
close #47273 

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

This PR addresses 2 issues
1. EBS snapshot restore can do FSR based warmup to tikv data volumes. A new parameter of`use-fsr` is introduced to  `br` command. Set it to `true` to use FSR to warmup tikv data volumes.
2. Get rid of unnecessary removal of some users from mysql.user table at the end of restore

issue_context.title: ebs br: don't change mysql.user table
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

Use EBS snanpshot to restore a cluster, which contains user with name prefix of "cloud_"

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
No content change to mysql. user table

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
Some users in mysql.user are removed after restore

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

review_comments: We should wait all the fsr finished before restore volumes.
we should add the `snapshot-id` filter. We should only watch the fsr we created.
